title: The MallWorld has terrible Health and Safety
content: Anyone else gotten on an escalator in the MallWorld, only to realise it has absolutely no barriers/handrails? Combine that with the escalator being on the top floor, and suddenly changing direction. But there is a gap between the escalators. Meaning that you have to jump to change directions, or the escalator will just carry you all the way off the edge. None of the other customers seem to think this is poorly designed. I haven’t fallen off yet, but maybe that’s because I wake up just before I have to make the jump. Oh, MallWorld.
